content.short: OpenMask is a browser extension wallet for TON, designed to offer a seamless 'MetaMask-like' experience for web dApps.
content.description: OpenMask is an open-source browser extension wallet for the TON blockchain, offering a familiar and intuitive experience similar to MetaMask. It supports TON Connect 2.0, allowing users to interact seamlessly with web-based decentralized applications. With its focus on accessibility and developer-friendly features, OpenMask serves as a critical bridge for users navigating the growing world of TON dApps, providing secure storage and transaction management directly within the browser.
content.meta: Discover OpenMask, the premier browser extension for TON. Interact with dApps seamlessly on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
